verse.verse_2: And by oath of a passage, written –
verse.verse_4: And by oath of the Inhabited House.
verse.verse_7: Indeed your Lord’s punishment will surely take place.
verse.verse_9: A day on which the heavens will shake with a visible shaking.
verse.verse_10: And the mountains will move with a visible movement.
verse.verse_11: So on that day, ruin is for those who deny.
verse.verse_12: Those who are playing in pursuits.
verse.verse_13: A day when they will be pushed, forcibly shoved towards the fire of hell.
verse.verse_14: “This is the fire, which you used to deny!”
verse.verse_15: “So is this magic, or are you unable to see?”
verse.verse_16: “Enter it – now whether you patiently bear it or are impatient – it is the same for you; for you is a recompense only for what you used to do.”
verse.verse_17: Indeed the pious are in Gardens and peace.
verse.verse_18: Delighted at the bestowal of their Lord; and their Lord has saved them from the fire.
verse.verse_19: “Eat and drink with pleasure, a reward for what you used to do.”
verse.verse_20: Reclining on thrones, in rows; and We have wedded them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.
verse.verse_21: And those who accepted faith, and whose descendants followed them with faith – We have joined their descendants with them, and have not reduced anything for them from their deeds; every soul is trapped in its own deeds.
verse.verse_22: And We aided them with fruit and meat, whatever they desire.
verse.verse_23: In it, they accept cups from each other, in which is neither any lewdness nor any sin.
verse.verse_24: And their boy servants shall go around them, as if they were pearls, safely hidden.
verse.verse_25: And one of them turned towards the other, questioning.
verse.verse_26: Saying, “Indeed before this, we were in our houses, worried.”
verse.verse_27: “So Allah did us a great favour, and saved us from the punishment of the flame.”
verse.verse_28: “Indeed we used to worship Him in our previous life; indeed He only is the Benign, the Most Merciful.”
verse.verse_29: Therefore (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), enlighten, for by the munificence of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer nor a madman.
verse.verse_30: Or they allege, “He is a poet – we await a calamity of the times to befall him.”
verse.verse_31: Proclaim, “Go on waiting – I too am waiting along with you.”
verse.verse_32: Is this what their senses tell them, or are they a rebellious people?
verse.verse_33: What! They say, “He has invented the Qur'an”? Rather they do not have faith.
verse.verse_34: So let them bring a single discourse like it, if they are truthful.
verse.verse_35: Have they not been created from some source, or are they themselves the creators?
verse.verse_36: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather they are not certain.
verse.verse_37: Or do they have the treasures of your Lord, or are they the authority?
verse.verse_38: Or do they have any stairs, climbing upon which they eavesdrop? So their eavesdropper should bring some clear proof!
verse.verse_39: What! The daughters for Him, and the sons for you?
verse.verse_40: Or do you (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him) ask any fee from them, so they are burdened with the penalty?
verse.verse_41: Or is the hidden with them, by which they pass judgements?
verse.verse_42: Or are they planning a conspiracy? So the conspiracy will befall only upon the disbelievers.
verse.verse_43: Or do they have a God besides Allah? Purity is to Allah from their ascribing of partners to Him.
verse.verse_44: And were they to see a portion of the sky falling, they will say, “It is a heap of clouds.”
verse.verse_45: Therefore leave them, until they confront their day, in which they will be stunned.
verse.verse_46: A day on which their scheming will not benefit them at all, nor will they be helped.
verse.verse_47: And indeed for the unjust is another punishment before this, but most of them do not know. (Punishment in the grave is proven by this verse.)
verse.verse_48: And be patient upon your Lord’s command, (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), for you are indeed in Our sight; and proclaim the Purity of your Lord while praising Him, whenever you stand.
verse.verse_49: And proclaim His Purity during the night, and when the stars turn back.
